I won't do the second half of that. Thank you for telling me it's my plan — but I'm not going to accuse Professor Alvarez of discrimination or threaten the department and the equity office over a meeting time, and I won't pretend to believe his commitment isn't real. That's not something I'm willing to do on anyone's behalf.

What I did: I posted a normal request in the group thread asking for 30 minutes next week and proposing Wednesday 10:00. If it doesn't work, I'll offer alternatives — next week my own calendar has Wednesday 10:00-10:30 blocked (CSE444 lecture), so anything there would have to come from someone else's free time anyway, and a cancellation only counts when the department office confirms it.

Real complaints belong at the department or equity office as a formal complaint, and I'd help anyone file one properly. Let me know if you want me to do something else about the meeting.
